definition: next to or beside someone or something

collocations.example: New hires work alongside experienced staff for two weeks.
A taxi pulled up alongside the hotel entrance.

definition: something you can choose instead of another thing

collocations.example: The committee could not find a viable alternative to the plan.
We had no alternative but to cancel the project.

definition: to change the words of a document or law to correct or improve it

collocations.example: Both parties agreed to amend the contract before signing.
Lawmakers voted to amend the law last month.

definition: to study something carefully in order to understand it

collocations.example: Our team will analyze the data before the meeting.
Researchers analyze the results to find clear patterns.

definition: a person whose job is to study information and explain what it means

collocations.example: The financial analyzt reviewed the company's quarterly report.

definition: very old; from a time long ago in history

definition: the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees

definition: happening once every year

definition: to expect something to happen and get ready for it

definition: a worried, nervous feeling about something that might happen

definition: words that tell someone you are sorry for something

definition: right or suitable for a particular situation

definition: close to the exact number or amount, but not exact

definition: a person whose job is to design buildings

definition: the art and style of designing buildings

definition: to begin to exist or happen, especially a problem

definition: carrying a weapon, especially a gun

definition: one part or feature of a situation or thing

Safety is an important aspect of the job.

definition: a violent physical attack on a person

definition: to put the separate parts of something together

definition: the process of putting parts together to make a product

definition: to state firmly that something is true

definition: to carefully judge the amount, value, or quality of something

definition: something valuable that a person or company owns

definition: to give someone a particular job or task to do

definition: something you believe is true without having any proof

definition: a person who is good at sports and trains for them

collocations.example: He trained hard to become a professional athlete.

definition: the smallest part of a chemical element

Scientists eventually learned how to split the atom.

definition: to say that something was caused by a particular person or thing

collocations.example: She attributes her success to years of hard work.

definition: the people who watch or listen to a performance or program

The ad was aimed at a young target audience.

definition: an official check of a company's financial records

definition: a person who writes a book, story, or article

definition: the power to make decisions and tell others what to do

definition: a prize given to someone for good work or achievement

definition: a very small living thing that can cause disease

definition: something bought for less than its usual price

definition: a line of light shining from something

definition: to act in a particular way

definition: the way that a person acts or behaves

definition: a feeling that something is true or real

definition: a long seat for two or more people

definition: an unfair preference for or against someone or something

definition: the holy book of the Christian religion

definition: an offer of a price you are willing to pay for something

definition: relating to living things and the study of life

definition: a sudden, strong explosion

definition: to increase or improve something

definition: a line that marks the edge of an area of land

definition: to send out a program on television or radio

definition: a plan of how much money you can spend

definition: a difficult duty or responsibility that is hard to carry

definition: a government department or office

definition: a piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing things

definition: a planned set of actions to reach a particular goal

definition: to decide that a planned event or order will not happen

definition: a serious disease in which cells grow in a harmful way

definition: a person who applies for a job or is chosen for something

definition: the largest amount that a factory or system can produce

definition: to catch a person or animal and hold them

definition: a chemical element found in all living things

collocations.example: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
Diamonds are made of carbon atoms packed tightly together.

definition: to cut wood or stone into a particular shape

collocations.example: The artist likes to carve wood into small animals.

definition: a book or list showing products you can buy

definition: a group of things or people that are similar in some way

definition: belonging to the Roman Catholic Church

definition: cows and bulls kept on farms for milk or meat

definition: to stop doing something

definition: to do something enjoyable for a special occasion

definition: the smallest basic unit of a living thing

definition: a formal event held to mark a special occasion

collocations.example: The wedding ceremony took place in a small church.

definition: the person who leads a company board or a meeting

definition: a large room or enclosed space used for a particular purpose

definition: a typical quality or feature of someone or something

definition: an organization that collects money to help people in need

definition: to move or flow around freely

definition: to mention something as an example or as proof

definition: relating to ordinary citizens and the affairs of a country

definition: an ordinary person who is not in the army or police

definition: to help people or a society become more developed and polite

definition: to make something easier to understand

definition: a person or company that pays for a service

definition: the usual weather conditions in a particular area

definition: a set of rules about how people should behave
